message.content:
**NORTHBANK COMMUNITY GARDEN**

**North gate closed Saturday 18 April, 9 am to 2 pm**

A leaking water pipe by the north gate needs repairing, so the gate will be shut from **9 am to 2 pm on Saturday 18 April**. The garden stays open. Come in through the **east entrance** instead.

**Seed swap moves to Sunday**

This month's seed swap will now be held on Sunday 19 April at 11 am, rather than on Saturday. Bring whatever seeds you have to share, and come along even if you have none to swap.

**Volunteers**

If you can spare some time on Saturday while the repair is under way, we would like to hear from you. Bring a pair of gloves. Tools are supplied, so there is no need to carry your own.

Mina, a Northbank resident, is coordinating volunteers. Tell her you are coming, and she will let you know how you can help.

If your plot is near the north gate, please plan your Saturday visit around the closure and enter by the east side.

Thanks, and see you on Sunday for the swap.

The Northbank Garden Committee
